name: Quick Smoke Suite
description: 8 short tasks (one per category) for a fast sanity check of a model. Runs in about a minute on CPU with a 1B model.

cases.prompt: What is the capital of Japan? Answer with the city name only.
What is 17 multiplied by 6? Reply with just the number.
If all bloops are razzies and all razzies are lazzies, are all bloops lazzies? Answer yes or no.
Return a JSON object with the keys "name" and "age" for a person named Sara who is 29 years old. Output only the JSON.
Describe the sun in at most 15 words.
cases.reference: The sun is a hot, glowing star at the centre of our solar system.

cases.prompt:
Summarize the following text in one sentence of at most 30 words.

Text: Local language models run directly on a personal computer instead of a remote server. Because prompts and documents never leave the machine, they are attractive for hospitals and banks that handle confidential data. The trade-off is that small local models are usually slower and less capable than large cloud models.
cases.reference: Local language models keep confidential data on the computer, which suits hospitals and banks, but they are slower and less capable than large cloud models.

cases.prompt: Extract the email address from this text: 'Contact Ali at ali.khan@example.org for details.' Reply with the email address only.
Classify the sentiment of this review: 'The battery died after one day, very disappointed.' Answer with one word: positive, negative or neutral.
